_doc: The experiments of the sandbox, see scripts/sandbox.gd. An experiment has a 'title' for the menu, the 'level' and the 'zone' of it that is the arena (the id the level gives the zone on its route), optionally a 'squad' (the roles that stand at the posts of that zone, in the order of the posts; without it, whoever the level has there) and its 'variants'. A variant has a 'name' and is otherwise a theme as assets/characters/manifest.json writes one: usually 'like' another theme with a 'tuning' on top, which sets exported variables of scripts/enemy.gd. An experiment is here to be decided: once it is, what won goes into the theme and the experiment goes.
